mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO NOTICE (NOTICE_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, TARGET, POSTED_AT, UPDATED_AT, IS_DELETED) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{target}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, TARGET = #{target}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId} AND IS_DELETED = 0
mapper.select:
SELECT N.NOTICE_ID, N.MEMBER_ID, N.UNIV_ID, N.TITLE, N.CONTENT, N.TARGET, M.MEMBER_NAME, N.POSTED_AT, N.UPDATED_AT FROM NOTICE N JOIN MEMBER M ON N.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID
N.IS_DELETED = 0 AND N.UNIV_ID = #{univId}
AND (N.TARGET = 'ALL' OR N.TARGET = #{role})
ORDER BY N.POSTED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SUPPORT (SUPPORT_ID, MEMBER_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_NAME, CONTACT, MESSAGE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_SUPPORT.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{univId}, #{memberName}, #{contact}, #{message}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT UNIV_ID, UNIV_NAME, SCHOOL_PHONE, HOMEPAGE, ADDRESS, YOUTUBE_URL, CLUB_URL, SNS_URL FROM UNIVERSITY ORDER BY UNIV_NAME
SELECT DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME, UNIV_ID FROM DEPARTMENT WHERE UNIV_ID = #{univId} ORDER BY DEPT_NAME
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LECTURE_CODE (LEC_CODE_ID, DEPT_ID, LEC_CODE, LEC_COD_NAME, VAL_STATUS) VALUES (SEQ_LECTURE_CODE.NEXTVAL, #{deptId}, #{lecCode}, #{lecCodName}, 'ACT')
MERGE INTO UNIV_HOME_CONFIG HC USING DUAL ON (HC.UNIV_ID = #{univId}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UNIV_ID, WEATHER, AI_CHAT, NOTICE, MEAL, TEL, SHORTCUT) VALUES (#{univId}, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1)
MERGE INTO UNIV_NOTICE_CONFIG NC USING DUAL ON (NC.UNIV_ID = #{univId}) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (UNIV_ID, DEFAULT_TARGET, SHOW_TOP, PUSH_ALERT) VALUES (#{univId}, 'ALL', 1, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT L.LEC_ID, LC.LEC_CODE_ID, LC.LEC_CODE, LC.LEC_COD_NAME, D.DEPT_ID, D.DEPT_NAME, D.UNIV_ID, U.UNIV_NAME, M.MEMBER_ID AS PROFESSOR_MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME AS PROFESSOR_NAME, S.SEM_ID, S.SEM_YEAR, S.SEM_TERM, L.LEC_SECTION, L.LEC_CREDIT, L.LEC_TOT_CLASSES, L.LEC_VAL_STATUS, (SELECT LISTAGG(LT.LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY LT.LEC_TIM_ID) FROM LECTURE_TIME LT WHERE LT.LEC_ID = L.LEC_ID) AS DAY_CODES, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MIN(LT.LEC_TIM_STR_TIME), 'HH24:MI') FROM LECTURE_TIME LT WHERE LT.LEC_ID = L.LEC_ID) AS START_TIME, (SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(LT.LEC_TIM_END_TIME), 'HH24:MI') FROM LECTURE_TIME LT WHERE LT.LEC_ID = L.LEC_ID) AS END_TIME FROM LECTURE L JOIN LECTURE_CODE LC ON LC.LEC_CODE_ID = L.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = LC.DEPT_ID JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = D.UNIV_ID JOIN SEMESTERS S ON S.SEM_ID = L.SEM_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE LP ON LP.LMS_PRF_ID = L.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = LP.MEMBER_ID WHERE L.LEC_ID = #{lecId}
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_LECTURE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LECTURE (LEC_ID, LMS_PRF_ID, SEM_ID, LEC_CODE_ID, LEC_REG_DATE, LEC_CREDIT, LEC_TOT_CLASSES, LEC_VAL_STATUS, LEC_SECTION) VALUES (#{lecId}, #{lmsPrfId}, #{semId}, #{lecCodeId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{lecCredit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{lecTotClasses, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'OPEN', #{lecSection})

INSERT INTO LECTURE_TIME (LEC_TIM_ID, LEC_ID, LEC_TIM_DAY_CODE, LEC_TIM_STR_TIME, LEC_TIM_END_TIME) VALUES (SEQ_LECTURE_TIME.NEXTVAL, #{lecId}, #{time.dayCode}, TO_TIMESTAMP(#{time.startTime}, 'HH24:MI'), TO_TIMESTAMP(#{time.endTime}, 'HH24:MI'))
mapper.update: UPDATE LECTURE SET LMS_PRF_ID = #{lmsPrfId}, SEM_ID = #{semId}, LEC_CODE_ID = #{lecCodeId}, LEC_CREDIT = #{lecCredit, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LEC_TOT_CLASSES = #{lecTotClasses, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, LEC_SECTION = #{lecSection} WHERE LEC_ID = #{lecId}
mapper.select: SELECT SEM_ID, SEM_YEAR, SEM_TERM, TO_CHAR(SEM_STR_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEM_STR_DATE, TO_CHAR(SEM_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SEM_END_DATE FROM SEMESTERS ORDER BY SEM_YEAR DESC, SEM_ID DESC
